response.overview: Genaro and Jay, two best friends navigating life on the south side of Atlanta, wake up to a crisis that derails their entire day: Jay's phone is missing, and it holds everything — his job info, his girl's messages, and a video that could get them both in trouble. What starts as a simple search spirals into a chaotic journey through their neighborhood as they retrace last night's steps, dodge people they owe, and uncover secrets they didn't expect. Along the way, the two are forced to confront their friendship, their choices, and the growing gap between who they are and who they want to be. By the time the phone finally turns up, nothing about their day — or their bond — is the same.
response.tagline: Two friends. One lost phone. Infinite chaos.
response.title: Bruh, Where My Phone
